aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds useful software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build useful software especially for food trucks and mobile caterers, so they can take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders running without interruption and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was made to change exactly that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is built with a fixed-address business in mind.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built around the way these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple point: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After building Village Foodie — a directory that helps people find the food trucks coming to their area — I spent more time understanding the challenges of mobile food businesses. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks keep moving, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the pickup times by which your kitchen can really have the order ready. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many are made at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fee: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {# month is free} other {The first # months are free}}, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the same place and day when you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported right now.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is charged each month in advance, and your access stays until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in your POS.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order shows up in your kitchen. A POS or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or financial year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a later date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each order.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give the order a buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen in front of customers that shows order numbers and also when an order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck shows on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before any of them expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date links straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with separate prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen display, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal goes.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are added and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos and offer add-ons at checkout, so the average order goes up.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions that come in on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal goes, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t even see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment up front via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a pre-order deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, each with its own private order link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs and see what you really earned at every event, not just your sales.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from the photo you already post on Facebook. You just look it over and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS as soon as their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times automatically for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count — it goes down as orders come in, and then the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, so the rush is spread across your whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders right at the truck, with payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Auto-replies to questions that come in on WhatsApp about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have one fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, and the mobile network is weak or not there at all. HatchGrab was built for exactly that.

landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
